not_on_report.definition: Gives the location of a place on Earth north or south of the equator. Lines of Latitude are the horizontal lines shown running east-to-west on maps (particularly so in the Mercator projection). Technically, latitude is an angular measurement in degrees ranging from 0 degrees at the equator (low latitude) to 90 degree at the poles (90 degree N or +90 degree for the North Pole and 90 degree S or −90 degree for the South Pole).

It is the angular distance measured east or west and usually expressed in degrees (or hours), minutes, and seconds, from the prime meridian, defined to be at the Royal Observatory, Greenwich, in England, to the meridian passing through another position on the surface of the earth.

FHA and the Mortgagee are the intended users of this report.

The VA is also an intended user of this report.
Additional Intended Users cannot be contrary to the original Intended User.

I have no present or prospective interest in the subject property, or relationship with the present or prospective owners or occupants of the
subject property, or other parties involved in this transaction.
I performed this assignment without bias with respect to the parties involved in this transaction, the subject property, or the demographics
of the area where the property is located.
I am aware of and have complied with all applicable laws and regulations including antidiscrimination laws, rules, and requirements that
apply to the appraiser and to the assignment.

identity), age (other than as applicable for legally age-restricted communities), marital status, disability, familial status, or national origin of the present or prospective owners or occupants of either the subject property or properties in the area of the subject property or on any other basis prohibited by the Fair Housing Act or the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, or any other basis prohibited by law.
I stated my own personal, unbiased, and professional analyses, opinions, and conclusions, which are subject only to the assumptions and

I certify that I did not perform a personal onsite inspection of the subject property to determine if the conditions or requirements stated in

and/or state laws (excluding audio and video recordings), or a facsimile transmission of this report containing a copy or representation of my signature, I agree that my electronic signature has the same force and effect as my manual handwritten signature, and that the report is enforceable and valid as a paper version of this report would be if delivered containing my manual handwritten signature.
Additional Appraiser Certifications cannot be contrary to the original Appraiser Certifications.

I have no present or prospective interest in the subject property, or relationship with the present or prospective owners or occupants of the

of the area where the property is located.
I am aware of and have complied with all applicable laws and regulations including antidiscrimination laws, rules, and requirements that
apply to the appraiser and to the assignment.
I accept full responsibility for this certification of completion.
The assignment information regarding the scope of inspection by the Supervisory Appraiser is correct.

compliance_rules.Message Text: The ZIP code for the subject property physical address must be either 5 digits, or 5 digits, a hyphen, and 4 digits (ZIP+4).
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If PostalCode is not in the required format (5 digits, or 5 digits, a hyphen, and 4 digits)

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the state code for the subject property physical address.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If StateCode is not provided

compliance_rules.Message Text: The state code for the subject property physical address must be a valid 2-character US State or Territory Code.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If StateCode is not a valid 2-character US State or Territory Code

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the 'Effective Date of Appraisal' from the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisalEffectiveDate is not provided

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Effective Date of Appraisal' from the original appraisal cannot be a future date.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisalEffectiveDate is in the future

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Effective Date of Appraisal' from the original appraisal must include year, month and day.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisalEffectiveDate does not include year, month and day in YYYY-MM-DD format

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Effective Date of Appraisal' from the original appraisal cannot be more than a year old.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisalEffectiveDate is more than 367 days before the current date.

compliance_rules.Message Text: 'Opinion Of Market Value' from the original appraisal must be at least one dollar and cannot be negative.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisedValueAmount < 1.

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Opinion Of Market Value' from the original appraisal must be less than a billion dollars.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisedValueAmount > 1,000,000,000

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the 'Opinion of Market Value' from the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraisedValueAmount is not provided.

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the Appraiser's name from the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraiserUnparsedName is not provided.

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the Appraiser's 'Reference ID' from the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalAppraiserFileIdentifier is not provided.

compliance_rules.Message Text: The MIMETypeIdentifier for the appraisal must be included as 'application/pdf' in the UAD XML. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If MIMETypeIdentifier is not provided or not provided as "application/pdf" in FOREIGN_OBJECT

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the location and file name of the appraisal (e.g., \\CR1_CompletionReport_v1.1.pdf). For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If ObjectURL is not provided in FOREIGN_OBJECT

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the Lender's name from the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If OriginalLenderUnparsedName is not provided.

compliance_rules.Message Text: 'ServiceType' = 'Valuation' must be delivered once. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If there is no instance or more than one instance of SERVICE_DETAIL with ServiceType = "Valuation"

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the 'Inspection Date' for each repair item.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemRecommendedActionInspectionDate is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Inspection Date' must include year, month and day.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemRecommendedActionInspectionDate does not include year, month and day in YYYY-MM-DD format
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Inspection Date' cannot be more than a year old for each repair item.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemRecommendedActionInspectionDate is more than 367 days before the current date.
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'Inspection Date' cannot be a future date for each repair item.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemRecommendedActionInspectionDate is in the future
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the location of the defect, damage or deficiency.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If ((PropertyValuationConditionalConclusionType = "SubjectToRepair" and CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "false") or CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "true") and DefectItemLocationType is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide a description of the defect, damage or deficiency.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemDescription is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Indicate whether the defect, damage, or deficiency affects the soundness and / or structural integrity of the improvement.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemAffectsSoundnessStructuralIntegrityIndicator is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the recommended action for the identified defect, damage or deficiency.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "true" and DefectItemRecommendedActionType is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL

compliance_rules.Message Text: Indicate whether a new defect, damage, or deficiency is identified as part of the completion report and was not included within the original appraisal.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If PropertyValuationConditionalConclusionType = "SubjectToRepair" and CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL

compliance_rules.Message Text: Indicates whether the defect, damage or deficiency has been resolved or satisfied.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If (PropertyValuationConditionalConclusionType = "SubjectToRepair" and CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "false") and DefectItemRecommendedActionCompletedIndicator is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide a description of the recommended action for the defect item.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If (PropertyValuationConditionalConclusionType = "SubjectToRepair" and CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "false" and DefectItemRecommendedActionCompletedIndicator = "false") and DefectItemRecommendedActionCompletionDescription is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the feature where the defect, damage or deficiency has been observed.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If ((PropertyValuationConditionalConclusionType = "SubjectToRepair" AND CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "false") OR CompletionReportNewDefectIndicator = "true") AND DefectComponentLabelType is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: New Observed Items for Repair; Itemized List of Repairs

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide a description when label of the defect, damage or deficiency = 'Other'.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectComponentLabelType = "Other" and DefectComponentLabelTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide a description when the location of the defect, damage or deficiency = 'Other'.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If DefectItemLocationType = "Other" and DefectItemLocationTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of DEFECT_DETAIL
compliance_rules.Report Section: Itemized List of Repairs; New Observed Items for Repair

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the file name and location of the image within the .zip file (e.g., \\Images\CR1_Dwelling_Front.png). For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If ImageFileLocationIdentifier is not provided in a given instance of IMAGE

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide the format of the image file. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If MIMETypeIdentifier is not provided in a given instance of IMAGE

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'from' label included in a RELATIONSHIP container is missing from the associated container. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If the associated container does not have the xlink:from label specified in a given instance of RELATIONSHIP

compliance_rules.Message Text: The 'to' label included in a RELATIONSHIP container is missing from the associated container. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If the associated container does not have the xlink:to label specified in a given instance of RELATIONSHIP

compliance_rules.Message Text: One or more duplicate RELATIONSHIP containers exist. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If the 'xlink:arcrole', 'xlink:from', and 'xlink:to' labels are not unique across all instances of RELATIONSHIP

compliance_rules.Message Text: Provide a description when party role type = 'Other'.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If PartyRoleType = "Other" and PartyRoleTypeOtherDescription is not provided in a given instance of ROLE_DETAIL

compliance_rules.Message Text: The exterior inspection method, interior inspection method, and inspection date must be delivered no more than once for each Appraiser and/or Supervisory Appraiser. In the UAD XML, only one instance of INSPECTION_DETAIL must be included for each Appraiser and/or Supervisory Appraiser. For assistance with this message, contact the appraisal software vendor.
compliance_rules.Rule Logic: If PartyRoleType = "Appraiser" or "AppraiserSupervisor" and (no instance of INSPECTION_DETAIL is provided for each role or more than one instance of INSPECTION_DETAIL is provided for each role) has context menu
